reason: At 23 euros a litre it costs me about double my Monin, and in my snack bar nobody pays extra for a signature cocktail. Plus it's another supplier, deposit bottles to manage, and I don't know if it keeps once I open it.
objection: It's fermented: how long does it last once opened, does it need the fridge, and will it taste the same every delivery? With Monin I know exactly what I get and I never run out.
would_change_my_mind: A price closer to 15 euros, plus written proof it keeps several weeks opened without the fridge and arrives with my usual distributor order.
